decision: worked in a separate worktree on branch frontend-tanstack-tailwind and committed the uncommitted Dashboard redesign as the first commit
why: the migration rewrites Dashboard.tsx and styles.css, which had uncommitted edits; a worktree leaves the main checkout exactly as it was

decision: done = typecheck+build green, gate script finds no legacy router/useApi/CSS classes, every route screenshot pixel-identical to baseline, behavior script green
why: the migration should change the stack, not how the app looks or behaves, so old-vs-new screenshots and scripted clicks are the proof

decision: order: harness, then Tailwind (spike first), then Query, then Router
why: Tailwind pixel parity is the biggest unknown because preflight and its type scale change line heights; Query and Router are mechanical swaps

decision: no fan-out to subagents for the conversion
why: about 1500 lines sharing one theme file; parallel workers would collide on the theme and drift in style

decision: built visual.mjs (40 screenshots: 7 routes plus 3 fixture states, light/dark, 1280/600 wide) and behavior.mjs (11 scripted checks)
why: need old-vs-new proof for both looks and behavior before touching the stack
result: baseline captured twice: 40/40 identical; behavior 11/11 on old stack

decision: added stubbed fixtures for recurring streams, budgets, upcoming bills and net worth history
why: seed DB has none of these, so their styles (meters, dimmed rows, sparkline) would never be screenshotted

decision: seeded control: changed --border by one unit and re-captured
why: a diff tool that never reports a mismatch proves nothing
result: 20/40 differ (all light shots, dark redefines --border): harness catches 1-unit color shifts

decision: dropped /oauth from screenshots; behavior check asserts it ends on /accounts
why: with nothing pending, Plaid init fails, onExit fires, and the page redirects to /accounts immediately; that predates this work

decision: ran worktree servers on 3002/5174 via new API_PORT env in vite.config
why: your own dev servers from the main checkout hold 3001/5173

decision: swapped the whole stylesheet at once instead of page by page
why: old unlayered rules for table/input/h1 beat every Tailwind layer, so mixing the two would make each page's diff meaningless

decision: kept preflight, set root line-height back to normal, and made a pixel-named type scale (text-13, text-14...) with no line heights
why: preflight's line-height 1.5 and Tailwind's text-sm/leading pairs would shift every row; pixel names make the exact sizes readable

decision: breakpoints md=761px and lg=1001px with mobile-first classes
why: old CSS used max-width 760/1000; min-width 761/1001 is the exact complement at whole-pixel widths

decision: shared pieces as React components and class tokens in components/ui.tsx, not @apply or @layer components
why: utilities stay in markup; Button variants are a closed type so ConnectButton can't receive arbitrary class strings

decision: first pass: 28/40 identical; Budgets and Transactions off by the input placeholder color
why: preflight sets placeholders to 50% currentColor; browser default is #757575

decision: one run showed 1 pixel off by 1 in a red channel on budgets.desktop.dark; recapture was clean
why: render noise, not a style difference; baseline itself was captured twice with 0 diffs

decision: added hover shots (sidebar link, inline category select); recaptured their baseline from stashed old code with an aside.sidebar marker check
why: an earlier provenance check compared two identical-looking outputs and proved nothing
result: old DOM confirmed before and after capture

decision: Tailwind unit landed
visual diff now ignores pixels off by 2 color units or less
why: Budgets button corners flaked by 1 unit between identical runs; I wasted many captures chasing it before the user stopped me
result: noisy capture q2 48/48; real placeholder bug (24 units) still fails

decision: replaced useApi/DataVersion with a queryOptions registry and useMutation + invalidation
why: typed per-endpoint queries; invalidation replaces the global bump counter; retry off keeps error display immediate

decision: tried code-based routes first; dropped them for file-based routes
why: a probe Link to='/nope' compiled: code-based route paths came out as any under both TS 7 and TS 5.9; the generated route tree declares paths explicitly

decision: moved Transactions filters into validated URL search params
why: the main gain TanStack Router offers here: filtered views survive reload and are shareable

decision: router unit landed
added check-stack.mjs to npm run typecheck
why: keeps react-router and hand-written CSS classes from coming back
result: planted react-router import and .card rule both fail; clean tree passes

decision: generated .claude/skills/verify (launch, doctor, cleanup, 5-feature map) reusing behavior.mjs and visual.mjs
why: user asked for a verification skill; the committed Playwright scripts already drive the real UI

decision: first launch hung: wrapper subshells held the eval $(...) pipe; switched to exec with group redirect
why: found by running the skill, not by reading it

decision: doctor aborted under set -u when a port had no owner; defaulted args
why: a dead instance must fail every check, not exit 1 by accident

decision: drove Budgets with real writes: PUT, reload shows row, DELETE via UI, DB empty after
why: proof must exercise the real path and read the side effect back

decision: ran behavior.mjs against the production build served by Express (npm run build, NODE_ENV=production)
why: dev server passing does not prove the built app, code-split route chunks, or SPA fallback for deep links with query strings
result: 12/12; my separate curl probe broke on a zsh glob and proved nothing

decision: final state: typecheck + check-stack + build green, visual 48/48 vs pre-migration baseline, behavior 12/12 dev and prod
why: the Phase A predicate
